name: Beast Form
description:
You transform a creature into the form of a beast.

Choose a creature within 10 spaces. An unwilling creature may make an opposed Resilience check to resist the effect.

For 1 hour, the creature is transformed into an animal of your choosing, provided the animal's maximum Stamina is no more than the target's maximum Stamina.

The target's statistics, including Attributes, Skills, and Abilities are replaced by those of the chosen beast. It retains its personality, Stamina, and Wounds.

While in its new form, the target is limited by the beast's capabilities, such as speech and the ability to wield tools.

Any equipment the target is weapon remains where it was, but the target may not be able to benefit from the equipment. For example, a gorilla may be able to wear a cuirass, but a wolf cannot use a spear.

The target returns to its natural form if it takes Damage equal to the maximum Stamina of the animal or if it falls to 0 Stamina. Any Damage taken while in the bestial form, including Damage in excess of the animal's maximum Stamina, carries over to the creature's natural form.
